biggest_catch: REJECT — AppStation is a real, actively maintained app from a named publisher, but the company publishes no concrete payout terms: no minimum redemption and no coin-to-dollar conversion appear in any official source; the only concrete figures (£0.50 PayPal at 6,399 points) come from third-party blogs.
catches: The developer's own Play Store description (returned verbatim in search) promises coins 'EVERY minute you play' and gift cards/PayPal, with a 4,444-coin welcome bonus — but states no minimum redemption and no coin conversion rate.

A developer website (appstation.online) is listed in the Play Store metadata, but it carries no obtainable terms or redemption schedule — a search for official payout terms returned only third-party content.
Third-party sources cite concrete figures (PayPal minimum 6,399 points = £0.50; 5,555 signup coins ≈ $0.50; Amazon 31,044 coins = £2.50) — none of them the company.
The listing copy is near-identical to the Coin Pop / Money Well / Fitplay clone family ('The one and only cash app that actually payout'), a template-operator pattern.
Same checklist bar as the Mistplay rejection (R0161): legit publisher, no concrete payout in official terms — stays unverified; rejection logged rather than forcing a positive.

c1.evidence: AppStation: Games & Rewards is published by 'App Station Company' — Google Play listing live, ~294K reviews at 4.2 stars, 4,444-coin welcome bonus still advertised; active publisher.

c2.evidence: FAIL — no concrete payout terms published by the company itself: official listing describes coins-per-minute and gift-card/PayPal redemption but states no minimum redemption, no coin-to-dollar conversion, and no per-game payout. All specific figures are third-party.

c3.evidence: No upfront fee — listing: 'Get AppStation completely for free... doesn't require in-app purchases.'

c4.evidence: FAIL — official sources obtained (company's own Play Store listing, developer website appstation.online) carry mechanics only; no official source with concrete payout figures was obtainable.

eligibility: Free app on Android; iOS availability unconfirmed in official sources obtained.
notes: Terms-concreteness rejection, not a legitimacy rejection — the app is live and actively reviewed. If App Station Company publishes a redemption schedule officially, re-check. Note: the android app_links URL was returned verbatim in the search results of this session (the company's own Play Store listing).

s1.note: Free app; Android; age/region terms not published on official pages obtained.

s2.note: No participation fee; conversion unquantifiable from official sources.

s3.note: Third parties report ~24-hour PayPal payouts; no official timing published.

s4.note: No weasel-word analysis performed — the route fails on missing concrete official terms, not on vague official language.

s5.note: FAIL — official mechanics sources exist but carry no concrete payout figures.

s6.note: FAIL — concrete steps with official figures cannot be stated; any earnings steps would rely on third-party figures.

s7.note: Company's own Play Store listing is official but insufficient for the payout-terms bar.
